apps.name: Vibefy Preview
apps.localizedDescription: Mobile preview with on-device audio-only YouTube playback: M4A/AAC streaming with artwork, without loading a video player. Includes QR playlist imports, protected Google renewal, persistent playlist metadata, backups and Jam controls. Provider restrictions still apply. Existing account and playlist data is retained. Background behavior depends on the device; physical-device validation remains ongoing. Android uses NewPipeExtractor (GPL-3.0-or-later); iOS uses YouTubeKit (MIT).
